outline:
修本課程之學生必須是已經具備國手身分，參加國際選手訓練期間可以同時修讀本課程及「專業深根實習一」，學生必須每星期至少5天至訓練單位或企業實習。不但可以專心參加選手訓練，同時可以修實習學分。修此課程，必須先提出申請，經技優專班辦公室核准。
Students who take this course must already have a national identity. During the training of international players, you can take this course and "Professional Deep Internship (1)" at the same time. Students must go to the training unit or the business for an internship at least 5 days a week. Not only can you concentrate on participating in player training, but you can also take internship credits. To take this course, you must first submit an application, which is approved by the Office.
